commandList.name: The Ring
rules: Your Ring-bearer is legendary and can't be blocked by creatures with greater power.
Whenever your Ring-bearer attacks, draw a card, then discard a card.
Whenever your Ring-bearer becomes blocked by a creature, that creature's controller sacrifices it at end of combat.

rules: At the beginning of each player's precombat main phase, if that player has one or more rad counters, mill that many cards. For each nonland card milled this way, you lose 1 life and remove one rad counter.
